inductorCouplings.description: Coupled inductor pairs (SPICE K), absent when none: each member's dotPin is its dotted end; arrow:false hides the curved arrow. Change with couple-inductors, remove with delete {kind:'inductor-coupling'}.

cellTerminal.description: A Cell Pin marker's formal terminal. Such a marker has no Reference; this is its name.

annotations.description: Asked for with instanceLabels: the part's name, value and parameter labels (a Cell Pin marker's name label too), by annotation id; absent when it has none.
